prompt: The cramped interior of a deep-sea research submarine. The main view is of a large, circular porthole showing dark blue water. A crew member's station has a glowing sonar screen next to a control panel with various levers and a prominent pressure gauge. A red fire extinguisher is mounted on the wall next to a tangle of pipes and a large valve. A heavy bulkhead door is visible in the background. Coiled cables run along the floor. A clipboard with a pen is attached to the wall. A laptop computer sits on a small fold-out desk next to a headset. A first aid kit is strapped above the station. The environment is strictly functional and enclosed; there are no potted plants and certainly no comfortable sofa. Being underwater, there is no window with a view of the sky, and for safety, there is no open flame or bookshelf with paper books. It is a workspace, so there is no pet cat.
